svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Personal branding is two different jobs, and most people pick the wrong one
svg.desc: Job one is deepening trust with a known, small audience: the few dozen people in a position to send you work. Job two is building reach with an unknown, large audience. Almost everyone needs the first and spends their effort on the second.
svg.text: TWO DIFFERENT JOBS UNDER ONE NAME
Deepen trust with aknown, small audience
The few dozen people who are in a positionto send you work.
Build reach with anunknown, large audience
A large audience of strangers, which is rarelythe same list of people.
Almost everyone needs the first and spends their effort on the second.
The test: can the twenty people who could refer you describe what you do in one sentence?
